title: Why does the original Game Boy battery really last a decade?

scenes.text: Original Game Boy batteries last up to 10 years?
People think the battery is a cheap, low‑capacity cell that just wears out quickly.
scenes.label: Cheap battery myth

scenes.text: It uses a 1.2 V AA alkaline cell that can hold a charge for 10‑12 years when unused, thanks to low power draw of the LCD and processor.
scenes.label: AA alkaline longevity
Low Power Wins
scenes.sub: The handheld’s efficient design keeps the battery alive for years.

description: The Game Boy’s legendary battery life isn’t a myth—its design truly makes a simple AA cell last for a decade. Discover the engineering behind it.
